doc: Read a soft body's place, squash, speed and contacts, push it, step it, return to a frame, and ask what would be.

tools.name: body.observe
tools.description: The frame, the state's hash, the body's centre, bounds, area against its rest area, its fastest particle's speed, and what it touches

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: contacts are left out from the last, and `more` says how many

tools.name: body.particles
tools.description: Each particle's place and velocity, in order around the ring

tools.name: body.push
tools.description: What acts on the body from the next step on, held until the next push: a force on the whole of it, a walk along what it stands on; and once, on the next step alone, a kick
tools.undo: body.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the body: the push acts from the next step

force.description: [x, y], an acceleration added to gravity

tools.name: body.step
tools.description: Steps the body under what is held
tools.undo: body.seek to the frame it began at

then.why: read where the body is now

steps.description: how many (1 when none is given)

tools.name: body.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept; what is stepped from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none within the body: what came after the frame is another branch's

then.why: read the body at the frame returned to

tools.name: body.branch
tools.description: What would be: the body some steps ahead under a given push, observed as body.observe does; the body itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

tools.name: body.contacts
tools.description: What the last step touched, in words: its place, its squash, its speed, its contacts by kind, and the stages a step goes through

tasks.name: see-where-it-is
tasks.summary: Read where the body is and what it touches, as numbers and in words

tasks.name: push-and-watch
tasks.summary: Kick the body, step it, and read where it went

tasks.name: ask-before-pushing
tasks.summary: See where a kick would take it some steps ahead, the body itself untouched
